Done. The fix is diagnosed, applied, and verified against the real repo (`totalwindupflightsystems/inference-estimator`).

## Deliverables

**Solution document:** `/home/kara/solution.md` — title, root-cause analysis, exact fix (full replacement code), and verification, self-contained.

**Fixed working copy:** `/tmp/inference-estimator` (`cluster-estimator.html` + `test.js` changed, `dist/` regenerated).

## Root cause (summary)

`loadModelLibrary()` fired all 60 model fetches in a single `Promise.all` burst with `{cache:'no-store'}`, and treated a dropped request as "model intentionally absent": `if (!r.ok) return` plus an empty `catch`. No retry, and the success toast was computed only from what loaded — the manifest's 60 was never compared, so `Loaded 59 models` shipped with zero signal. The drop itself is a one-off cold-load/CDN event (the same file loads 60/60 on reload).

## Fix

Replaced the loader with one that:
1. **Bounds concurrency** — waves of 8 (`mapWithPool`) instead of a 60-way burst;
2. **Retries per file** — up to 3 tries with linear backoff + jitter, so a transient drop self-heals without aborting the pool;
3. **Reconciles against the manifest** — if anything is still missing, the toast is a red warning stating `Partially loaded 59 of 60 models — missing: <ids>` instead of a silent success line.

Helpers are nested inside `loadModelLibrary()` so the `build-standalone.js` splice still yields a `fetch()`-free standalone (verified: `60 models embedded, 0 fetch() calls`).

## Verification (all green on the fixed tree)

- New **test.js Group 11** replays the exact symptom deterministically: **8 page loads, a different model dropped on first fetch each time → toast `Loaded 60 of 60` and 60 `MODEL_PRESETS` keys every run** (this is the problem's own verification recipe); plus a permanent-404 negative case proving the warning toast names the missing id (`Partially loaded 59 of 60 — missing: bonsai-27b`). Passes 9/9 across 3 consecutive runs, including the originally observed victim `qwen2.5-0.5b`.
- `node test.js` → 10/11 groups pass; the single failure (`Board evidence`, dangling commit hash for IE-GAP-005) is **pre-existing and unrelated** — the hash doesn't exist in the upstream history and I touched nothing under `.coding-hermes/`.
- `node scripts/build-standalone.js` + `scripts/verify-standalone.js` pass; dist-freshness markers intact.
- Live-site manual check documented in the markdown (hard-refresh N times; status must read `Loaded 60 of 60 models from library ✓`, zero `[model-library] … failed` console warnings).

Fix direction: retry failed fetches once (or N times) before giving up; count expected-vs-loaded from manifest and surface a warning toast when loaded < manifest length.
